description: This file defines the Sdg class, which models a Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) within the Goteo project. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, saving, and validating SDGs, as well as managing associated icons and localization.

classes.name: Sdg
classes.description: Model class representing a Sustainable Development Goal with properties, data retrieval, persistence, and validation methods.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the database fields that support localization for name, description, and link.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific SDG by ID, optionally in a specified language.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns a list of SDGs, optionally filtered by certain criteria, with support for pagination and count.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the icon associated with the SDG, optionally forcing the asset retrieval.

methods.name: setIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon for the SDG either from an Image object or a filename.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the SDG object to the database, performing insert or update as needed, with validation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if the SDG object has valid data before saving.
